elements.content:
There is a sweet maiden asleep by the sea.

Her lips are as red as a cherry.

The roses are resting upon her brown cheeks.

Her cheeks are brown as a berry.

She’s tired of building up castles of sand.

Softly I will sing you a lullaby song.

And soon you will slumber most sweetly.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

elements.content:
有一个甜美的少女在海边熟睡。

她的嘴唇像樱桃一样红。

玫瑰花轻倚在她棕色的脸颊上。

她的脸颊像是棕色的浆果。

她玩累了堆沙堡的游戏。

我会轻声为你唱一首摇篮曲。

很快你就会睡得很香甜。

child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
